title: Compact sections of a quasi-compact etale geometric fibre
statement:
Let $h:V\to T$ be a separated quasi-compact etale morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field and $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Set $V_{\bar t}=V\times_T\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, with projection $r:V_{\bar t}\to V$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $I$ be the set of morphisms $\bar v:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to V$ satisfying $h\bar v=\bar t$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-fibre]. Then $I$ is finite and the canonical morphism $\coprod_{\bar v\in I}\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to V_{\bar t}$ is an isomorphism over $\Omega$.

Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $F$ a constant-$A$ module sheaf on $V_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $G=r^{-1}F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Write $H^0_c(V_{\bar t},G)$ for the $A$-module of global sections of $G$ whose closed support of nonzero geometric germs, with its reduced induced closed subscheme structure, is proper over $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [lem-cbc-proper-support-sheaf-composition, lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Every global section of $G$ has such support, and restriction to the components followed by the inverse-image germ identification gives a natural $A$-linear isomorphism
$$H^0_c(V_{\bar t},r^{-1}F)\xrightarrow{\sim}\bigoplus_{\bar v\in I}F_{\bar v},$$
where stalks are geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. More precisely, let $W\to T$ be etale, $\bar w:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to W$ lie over $\bar t$, let $t:W\to V$ be a lift over $T$, and let $z\in F(W\xrightarrow{t}V)$. Extend $z$ by zero off the clopen graph of $t$ in $V\times_TW$. The pullback of this section to $V_{\bar t}$ maps to the germ of $z$ at $\bar w$ in the summand indexed by $t\bar w$, and to zero in every other summand.
